brief: Early-1990s discount superstore on the edge of town: one huge single-storey box of painted concrete block and ribbed metal panels with a flat roof, a raised entrance vestibule with a red-and-white banded fascia and big letters, cart corrals, and a sea of parking with tall light poles. Garden centre fenced off at one end, loading docks behind.

stores.sign: TAMSIN SUPERCENTER · Grocery · Pharmacy · Garden · Open 24 Hours
